variant_domain: 112x112 aligned BGR enrollment crop; no new probe transforms or redetection of synthetic crops
pooling: unit-normalized mean of one original and five equally weighted variants; originals-only policies use identical cached features
growth_core: first ten identities of existing frozen development known-ID order, chosen before new scoring
growth_thresholds: existing 55-identity few-photo development thresholds, fixed for every gallery composition
scope: Descriptive paired development ablations; calibration reuses development probes and is not held-out evidence. Growth repeats vary composition, not independent people.
